faq.q: Will other people join my group?
faq.a: No — every booking is private. As long as your group meets the room minimum, no one will be in the room unless you bring them with you!

faq.q: What if I don't have 4 people?
faq.a: Our rooms are designed for a minimum of 4 people (6 for Zombie on a Chain). We can make exceptions, but smaller groups are still required to pay for the minimum of 4 people.
Yes! We are appointment only. Reservations must be made at least 2 hours in advance, either over the phone or online. A credit card is required to reserve a room.
You can add people up to the room maximum — 10 people in most rooms (8 in The Heist). If you have already booked, please give us a call and we can add them.

Our escape rooms are $26.99 per person (plus tax). Groups booking multiple rooms can use our flat group rate of $212.40 per room (plus tax). A deposit is required to reserve; full payment is not charged until after your game.

Our rooms are intended for those 12 and up. Kids 12 and older must be accompanied by a responsible adult at all times. Kids 4 to 11 can participate when a group books an entire room. Kids 0 to 3 are not required to pay and are allowed when a group books an entire room.
Arrive a few minutes early. The door is locked M-F until your game master opens it. Games typically last 60 minutes; plan on staying at least an hour and a half.

Limited parking in the back, along the street in front of the building, and on the street on the north side. You can also park in the corner lot to the north on weekday evenings after 5 and on Saturdays.
Most people wear normal clothes. However, feel free to dress up and get in character for your particular room or mission!

faq.q: Do you have a student discount?
faq.a: With a Starving Student Card you can use EITHER the 50% off discount OR a maximum of 2 free admissions per booking. Starving Student Cards are only accepted Monday through Thursday.

faq.q: Can we play outside business hours?
faq.a: We are happy to schedule a game outside of business hours. Just email us at provo@getoutgames.com.
